title: Making Luck ep. 25 review: Jack of All Trades, Scrying Pool, Mining Village, Seaway, Wolf Den

sources.author: Adam Horton and Jake
sources.note: Making Luck ep. 25, review of the ep. 24 kingdom, 8:52-21:30; games played against each other, WanderingWinder and bots

quality_note: Two top players report on games against each other, WanderingWinder and bots; they agree on the opening, the build and the Seaway target, with a minor split on 5/2.

kingdom.setup_notes: Secret Cave's Heirloom: each player starts with a Magic Lamp in place of one Copper. Idol is a Fate card, so the Boons deck is used. Herbalist and Scrying Pool cost a Potion, so Potion is in the Supply.

edition: Kingdom from Adam Horton's ep. 24 description. Colonies not mentioned.
